1.completeDesc: Your keen senses have noticed an ice-breaking tool in the natural environment.

3.desc: Travel 10000 meters using ziplines, bounce pads, and ropes
3.completeDesc: Dijiang has made plans to research and develop a device capable of low altitude flight for you.

2.desc: Fall from a height of at least 20 meters and hit an enemy
2.completeDesc: Are they pieces of orbital debris? No! They're you and your operators.

3.desc: Complete "Crisis Calamity: Alleikhreos, Chiliarch" without using Foundite Weapons
3.completeDesc: In a manner most stern and harsh, the Maker crushed the fighter from the past.

2.desc: Find Smartie's "tribute"
2.completeDesc: Camaraderie? Trust? This cute little thing is treating you as a friend.

2.desc: Let [Nefarith, "Conqueror"] hold the place in stasis and lock your controlled operator in mid-air
2.completeDesc: Her wild ambitions are terrifying, but fearlessly you displayed your courage in her lockdown of despair.

2.desc: Use the defensive parry to intercept the Axe Armorbeast's ramming assault
2.completeDesc: But the Axe Armorbeast still refused to turn around. Shame.

1.desc: Explore the base of Type-C Tianshi Pillar
1.completeDesc: From the Xiranite structure of the Test Area Tianshi Pillar, you picked up the "flower bud" that has yet to bloom. A vision of new birth beyond senescence is yours to witness.

2.desc: While Ruan Yi is Infuriated, keep his Withering Touch active for at least 60s
2.completeDesc: With dessicated branches he made a deathly realm, yet you traversed freely within it.

2.desc: Kick 4 Originium Slugs till they fall
2.completeDesc: You helped four Originium Slugs move house.

2.desc: Reach the top of the Qingbo Stockade waterwheel
2.completeDesc: You reached the very top of the Qingbo Stockade waterwheel and witnessed the wonder of "water cascading from the heavens above".

2.desc: Complete side mission [Letter From a Messenger]
2.completeDesc:
A few tiny errands, a few packages to deliver. 
You met her under the sunset skies. Beautiful memories and moments shall be the gifts that fill her empty letter.

2.desc: Complete side mission [Danse Macabre]
2.completeDesc: The chase, the fresh scent of blood, and an old wound that still throbs with pain... Camille has sworn that his blood will forever be with the Endministrator.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Prologue - Process: Awakening]
3.completeDesc: You have returned to Talos-II.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅵ: Forged at the Very Beginning]
3.completeDesc: Zhuang Fangyi waited, and you finally arrived.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅶ: Bravely Breach the Hostile Winds]
3.completeDesc: You are prepared to stare down oblivion in its face. Though sealed away for many years, it is still the very manifestation of despair.

3.desc: Bid farewell to an instructor of Tanjian Hall
3.completeDesc: He has understood. The living devote their commitment to their blades.

3.desc: Span the chasm with a Xiranite bridge
3.completeDesc: A Xiranite bridge now links the present to the past. The road is now open to you.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅶ: Warily Returns the Wandering Vigile]
3.completeDesc: Gently her heart was kept afloat through the overlapping mire of death ... to the place where hope will sprout and grow.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅶ: Homecoming]
3.completeDesc: The weeping gash will no longer bring pain.

3.desc: Summon the fruit of a great technological endeavor
3.completeDesc: The future of frontier development has descended upon Valley IV.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Chapter Ⅰ Process Ⅰ: Fort Showdown]
3.completeDesc:
You have defeated the "Bonekrushing Fist". 
Embrace the Æther and usher in a new future? What is your opinion about Nefarith's speech?

3.desc: Witness an attack in progress
3.completeDesc:
You witnessed an unexpected "explosion". 
The Power Plant is apparently not as defensible as it seems.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Chapter Ⅰ Process Ⅲ: Cradle of the Ages]
3.completeDesc: You have defeated a partially revived Aggelos of massive proportions.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Chapter Ⅰ Process Ⅳ: Undying Cinders]
3.completeDesc: You and your team fought hard and sealed the rift that was about to devour the entirety of Valley IV.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Intermission: Conference of the Four]
3.completeDesc: Foreboding signs have appeared throughout Talos-II. Your journey is not yet complete.

3.desc: Reach an all-new city
3.completeDesc: You have reached Wuling City.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅲ: Surging From a Withered Spring]
3.completeDesc:
A promise and a choice.
The old way sank beneath pristine ripples, but where is the new path for these people?

3.desc: Part ways with Ardashir at a certain key location
3.completeDesc: Ardashir looks at you. He sees what you cannot, visions that you have forgotten.

3.desc: Complete main mission [Chapter Ⅱ Process Ⅴ: Battle of the Main Pillar]
3.completeDesc: She is a conqueror whose heart was ignited by ambition, who seeks to sacrifice tens of thousands for a glimpse into the forbidden realm. You have crushed the malice of Nefarith.

1.desc: Complete side missions [Illumination of Fate] and [Endeavor of a Lifetime]
1.completeDesc: A Snowpriestess left her writings and resolution ... and let the snow bury her destiny. Yet a soft, determined girl brushed it aside, and revealed her final fate.

2.desc: Complete side mission [Bell of Recollection]
2.completeDesc: The bell strikes again, my heart pursues illumination once more.

2.desc: Complete side mission [Let Fire Consume the Ashen Past]
2.completeDesc:
The scars of memories may change in the fire. 
Though fragments of the past have built up like imposing mountains, you took Laevatain's hand and left the unending corridor.

achv_quest_liino.name: "Like a Star Streaking Through the Boundaries"

2.desc: Complete side mission [Like a Star Streaking Through the Boundaries]
2.completeDesc: Endfield Industries is finally getting its very own celebrity brand idol... We gotta start the rehearsals, performances, and... Oh dear. There are just so many things to do.

2.desc: Complete side mission [A Fistful of Reflections]
2.completeDesc: Their fists question my resolve, but my Qi punches through the lands and challenges the very thunder itself.

achv_quest_typhoea.name: "A Winter Dream Fogged Deep in the Woods"

2.desc: Complete side mission [A Winter Dream Fogged Deep in the Woods]
2.completeDesc: You followed the seeking gaze, tracked down the guiding arrow, weathered the frigid winds through mist and dreams ... and heard Her echoes in the Snowy Forest.

2.desc: Complete side mission [Lone Wolf]
2.completeDesc:
Wulfgard found the truth and executed the traitor. 
He plunged that dagger in the earth before the grave... The Pack had changed. He knew what he had to do.

2.desc: Complete side mission [The Red Knight]
2.completeDesc:
When they arrived at the children's realm, the travelers stopped to rest their feet.
Who can remember the scraping of knees from forgotten seasons of childhood?

2.desc: Complete side mission [Love, Scream & The Prototype]
2.completeDesc:
A crate of pigments had arrived late. 
You followed Tata's trail and created various graffiti. In these colors, Yvonne saw the potential of reunion.

1.desc: Complete 30 exploration missions
1.completeDesc: You helped plenty of people with their problems.

2.desc: Complete 40 exploration missions
2.completeDesc:
You helped plenty of people with their problems. 
Not all of them involved combat, and your goal transcends monetary pay.

3.desc: Complete 50 exploration missions
3.completeDesc:
You helped plenty of people with their problems. 
Those who benefited from your assistance will help others in return. The people of Talos-II must learn to support one another.

1.desc: Shared facility receives 50 repairs
1.completeDesc: Your facility has received some repairs.

2.desc: Shared facility receives 200 repairs
2.completeDesc: Your facility has received plenty of repairs.

3.desc: Shared facility receives 500 repairs
3.completeDesc:
Your facility has received a massive amount of repairs. 
Evidently, you have helped many and the beneficiaries became rather attached to your facilities. They have done all that they could to keep the factory machines around.

2.desc: Receive 100 production assists from your friends
2.completeDesc: Production facilities you furnished aboard Dijiang are working efficiently, thanks to the generous help from your friends.

1.desc: Give 50 production assists to your friends
1.completeDesc:
You generously offered production assist to your friends. 
Your altruism is the reason why Talos-II can prosper.

1.desc: Take part in a total of 50 clue exchanges.
1.completeDesc:
You performed a certain number of clue exchanges. 
The world grows with your vision and the intel you have collected.
